purpose: Test whether V1.6/V1.6.1 weakness in 2024 is driven by repeated stop-and-reentry whipsaws and/or unfavorable market regimes.

researchPolicy.test2026: Descriptive only; already examined in earlier research.
researchPolicy.pointInTimeRule: Signal-day market regime is known at the close; any permitted entry occurs next session open.
researchPolicy.parameterPolicy: Use only the pre-declared V1.6 original stop and V1.6.1 best worst-year candidate; do not retune ATR in this step.

regimeFilters.NO_BEAR: Allow BULL and NEUTRAL only; reject BEAR/UNKNOWN new entries.
regimeFilters.BULL_ONLY: Allow only BULL signal-day new entries.

rankingRule: Rank by min(2024 total return, 2025 total return), not by best single-year return.
limitations: Regime is a broad market breadth state, not a sector-specific regime.
Cooldown is measured in that security's row/session index after a stop and can sacrifice valid fast recoveries.
Daily OHLC cannot reconstruct exact intraday stop path.
Current-listed security master and Yahoo history retain survivorship/data-source limitations.
2026 remains descriptive; forward Decision Ledger is the cleanest production validation.
